run_split_indices: run the script to split and save train valid test indices from split_dict.pt as numpy files
run_main_function: run the main function to load split_dict.pt and save each split index as a separate npy file
review_main_function: review the main function that loads a torch split dictionary and saves indices as numpy arrays
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to support a custom output directory for the saved index files
test_main_function: test the main function with a mock split_dict.pt containing train valid and test index arrays
